name: 85004 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85004 (Phoenix) has 297 nonprofit organizations. 144 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 123 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85004 (Phoenix) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85004 (Phoenix) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
